summary: Retest of the iteration 3 fixes plus a light regression. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (14 existing + 12 new in test_onboarding_fixes.py). frame_point {x:null,y:null}, x:1.5, x:-0.1, a missing y, or a string x all return 422. Valid and edge (0,1) frame_points are saved and read back correctly. A position dict with numbers and strings (anchor_id) is accepted, and a list value returns 422. The gate leaves /api/auth/*, /api/onboarding, /api/onboarding/* and /api/files/* open, and /properties and /issues return 403 until setup is done. HIGH bug FIXED: in PhotoTagger on web, clicking 60%/40% of the visible image saved frame_point {x:0.6, y:0.399} (checked in the API). The pin rendered exactly at the click point at 390x844 (234,385 vs 234,385) and at 1024x768 (614.4,318.1 vs 614.4,318.3). Clicking the letterbox area or a pin label opens no sheet, and clicking a pin opens the existing item for editing. Upload uses the new ImageManipulator API: a 2000px JPEG was stored at 1280x767, an 800px JPEG was stored at 800 (not enlarged), and 6 AI suggestions appeared. A Playwright dblclick on suggestion-0-add created exactly 1 item (spinner shown). Two programmatic clicks in the same JS tick still created a duplicate (state-based guard). Rentals shows the 'No amenities yet' badge and the Fix-it empty state shows the 'Your rental is set up. Now add the contractors…' copy. Regression passed: new account -> seeded property -> confirm -> starter rooms -> room upload -> add all -> done -> review (4 rooms / 6 items / 3 appliances) -> finish -> celebrate -> tabs. Demo login redirects to /onboarding, and direct navigation to /properties also redirects there. The demo account was NOT skipped or completed (flags still unset). One transient Cloudflare 502 was caused by an expo restart during testing and recovered.

minor.issue: ItemPatch has no frame_point/position fields, so the API silently ignores a frame_point sent in a PATCH (200, value unchanged). This is fine today, but repositioning a pin is impossible through PATCH if that is ever needed.

issues: The 'Take photo' button label is truncated to 'Take p…' in room-take-photo-button next to Upload
A property with no amenities shows the 'No amenities yet' badge AND the body text 'No amenities yet.', which is redundant. Consider body copy like 'Add amenities to track backups.'
The body now says 'Your rental is set up…' but the primary CTA still reads 'Load demo or add properties' (fixit-setup-properties-button). Consider 'Add contractors' when properties>0.

action_items: LOW: Make the suggestion add guard synchronous with a useRef (e.g. const addingRef = useRef(false); if (addingRef.current) return; addingRef.current = true; ... finally addingRef.current = false). The state-based `if (adding) return` can be bypassed by two clicks dispatched before React re-renders (reproduced with two programmatic clicks in one tick, which created a duplicate 'Microwave'). Normal dblclick is already blocked. Ref: /app/frontend/app/onboarding/room/[id].tsx:144-147. Apply the same guard to addAll.

LOW: The PhotoTagger web fallback uses nativeEvent.offsetX/offsetY, which are relative to the DOM element that was clicked. If the click lands on a child element (pin label, Animated wrapper), the offset is relative to that child. Today the coordinates fall outside 0..1 and are rejected, but on a photo that fills the canvas it could tag the top-left area. Safer: compute from pageX/pageY minus the canvas's measured page offset, or ignore taps unless e.target === e.currentTarget. Ref: /app/frontend/src/onboarding/PhotoTagger.tsx:34-36
LOW: The 'Take photo' label is truncated at 390px. Shorten it to 'Camera' or stack the buttons. Ref: room-take-photo-button
LOW: Copy polish: change the Fix-it CTA when properties>0, and drop the duplicate 'No amenities yet' body text on the Rentals card
critical_code_review_comments: uploadPhoto calls ctx.renderAsync(), then ctx.resize().renderAsync() on the same context. This works in testing (2000->1280), but the ImageRef/context SharedObjects are never released (consider ctx.release()/img.release() on native to avoid memory growth during multi-photo sessions).
Gate: ONBOARDING_OPEN prefixes now end with '/' plus an exact set {'/api/onboarding','/api/upload'}. This is correct, and /api/filesX and /api/onboardingX are not treated as open.
Backend FramePoint(ge=0, le=1) validation is correct and returns a clear 422.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested fixes verified (1 low-severity edge case in the double-tap guard)

seed_data_creation: Created test_ob_*/test_obui_* users with properties, rooms, items and files. All 16 users and their data were deleted from Mongo afterwards. The demo host was not modified: logged in only, gate redirect verified, onboarding flags still unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed via /tmp/ob/seed.py (register + POST /api/onboarding/property with body {name,address,geocode:GEO} + room). Note the 'geocode' key is a nested object. Test images: /tmp/ob/kitchen.jpg (800x479) and /tmp/ob/kitchen_big.jpg (2000px). To verify tagger pins, compute the contain-rect from the photo-tagger-canvas bounding box and the image ratio, click with page.mouse.click, then compare the photo-pin-* center. Expo may restart while you test (brief Cloudflare 502). Wait for login-email-input with a 60s timeout.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 3 HIGH bug (NaN frame_point on web) is resolved. The offsetX/offsetY fallback plus the Number.isFinite guard produce correct normalized coordinates, and the backend FramePoint model rejects non-finite or out-of-range values. Remaining double-tap edge: React state updates from discrete events are flushed after the current task, so two click events dispatched in the same task both see adding=null. A useRef guard fixes this.
